messages.subject: Pricing model — checking the shortfall mechanic
messages.plaintextBody:
James — quick one. Attached is the pricing and volume model we've been using internally. Can you confirm the shortfall payment is 15% of the difference between £3.2m and actual orders, not 15% of £3.2m? Want to make sure finance has it right.

Rebecca
